Seeing same issue here. zone.home correctly reports the # of people, other zones stick to 0.

The issue has been identified and working on a solution.

To clarify the source of the issue: To determine if a person is in a zone, we compare the object ID of a zone with the state of the person, however, the person state contains the friendly name of the zone. Thus it doesn't match.

review_comments: I might be totally wrong and in that case apologies - but I'm wondering how this works with cases where device_trackers are not providing lat, long and accuracy (e.g., as enabled by https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/62243 for mobile_app trackers for example). I get the impression from this code section (again, apologies if I missed something!) that they would not be counted towards being in zone (although they might be reported as being in zone in any case)
Actually, I just tried this out, creating a person with a single device tracker (Wi-Fi based). This person has state == home, but does not have latitude or longitude in attributes.

A person or device tracker can have an arbitrary state, but that doesn't tie them into zones.
Zones are purely based on coordinates.

For example, triggers and conditions on zones don't work without coordinates either.

Yes, fully agree that zones by definition have coordinates, and this makes sense!

However, conditions on zones do work without coordinates on the person/ device_tracker, they are just comparing states. In my opinion, we should do the same with the zone counter (i.e., state)

**My example:**

- One zone called home, with coordinates.
- 1 person, with a single device_tracker (e.g., wifi-based one, iOS App 2022.02 with name-only tracker, etc.) which is NOT reporting coordinates 

![Screenshot 2022-01-27 at 14 32 47](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26942220/151369227-d8fa06b8-8bef-4f8d-8759-508dc6f7b32a.png)

- state of this person is the name of the zone, e.g., `home`
- state attributes of the person do not contain coordinates (because the device tracker is not reporting coordinates)


**(Existing) Zone condition**
```
condition:
  alias: "Person at home"
  condition: zone
  entity_id: person.name
  zone: zone.home
```
The condition is true, although the person is not reporting coordinates

**(New) Zone state**
As per my understanding of this PR (but please correct me if I'm wrong), the person would not be included in the count that's the state of the zone, although it is being considered home by the zone condition. I think this would be inconsistent.

Apologies - I believe the automation I tested this with was faulty. You are fully right. Sorry!

I guess one might still discuss how to handle such cases where there is no latitude or longitude reported, but that is not the scope of this fix. Consider my comment closed (I believe I can't resolve it myself).

According to the condition logic, it raises a condition error when a zone condition is used on an entity without lat/long:

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/079439812037c8904fedef4554ca9554936521dc/homeassistant/helpers/condition.py#L816-L831
Yes, you are fully right @frenck - I've hidden my post above. Sorry for the confusion!
